_comment: Daleel's screen settings. examples are offered under the search box until the reader has asked anything, so an empty page shows what it can be asked, in both languages; each is asked as typed. tries is said under a search that found nothing, the ways a question is most often widened into one that finds something. more is how many passages Show more adds to the page. noAnswer is said when no passage covers enough of the question to count as an answer; closest is how many weak matches are then named, as the Research PBS has it.
